## Capability

Content the opening activity leaves for a later fetch. The body is large enough that the eager budget of the window that fetches it stops before this technique.

## Outputs

### surplus_note

What the step recorded, so the fetch has a field to return.

## Protocol

### 1. Record

Write a short note under surplus_note describing what this stop did. The paragraphs that follow are the body a walk measures.
